title: Chapter IV: In Memoriam
text:
Chapter IV

In Memoriam

"Not by lamentations and mournful chants ought we to celebrate the funeral of a good man, but by hymns, for in ceasing to be numbered with mortals he enters upon a heritage of a diviner life."—Plutarch.

We here pay tribute to the memory of all those of whom we have a record, who have ceased their labors upon this earth since the organized activities of this association began and have passed on to their reward in another world.

They were our comrades in days agone when what would now seem minor difficulties in daily routine of life were real and troublesome problems, challenging one's resourcefulness, initiative and determination to succeed. They did not falter, nor admit defeat, nor weaken in the hour of trial, but relentlessly pressed onward, unafraid and unabashed, until, finally they reached their goal. Thus, they inspired and encouraged us. We now revere and honor their memory.
